description: Create a Personio absence period when a Jira Service Management leave request is approved

flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key of the HR service project this flow watches.

flowVariables.name: REQUEST_ISSUE_TYPE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira work item type name of the request.

flowVariables.name: REQUEST_TYPE_NAME
flowVariables.instruction: JSM request type name for leave requests. Leave empty to accept every request of REQUEST_ISSUE_TYPE in the project; only do that if no other request type uses the same work item type and approved status.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_REQUEST_TYPE_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Field ID of the JSM Customer Request Type field (Settings > Issues > Custom fields), for example customfield_10010. Only read when REQUEST_TYPE_NAME is set.

flowVariables.name: APPROVED_STATUS_NAME
flowVariables.instruction: Jira status name the request moves to when its approval completes. The flow runs once, on the transition into this status.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_PERSONIO_PERSON_ID_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the Personio employee ID. Optional: when it holds a value the employee is looked up by ID instead of email.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_EMPLOYEE_EMAIL_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the email of the employee taking leave. The default, reporter, uses the requester; replace it with a custom field ID if requests are raised on someone's behalf or Jira hides email addresses.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_ABSENCE_TYPE_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the leave type. Required. Mapped through ABSENCE_TYPE_ID_MAP.

flowVariables.name: ABSENCE_TYPE_ID_MAP
flowVariables.instruction: Jira leave type value to Personio absence type ID (a UUID from GET /v2/absence-types), as Label=ID pairs separated by ;, for example Vacation=137a2048-...;Parental leave=a2c1.... A leave type that is not in the map stops the flow with a comment. Empty sends the Jira value unchanged as the ID.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_START_DATE_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the first day of leave. Required. A Jira date picker field.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_END_DATE_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the last day of leave. Required. A Jira date picker field.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_HALF_DAY_START_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the half-day flag for the first day. Optional; leave empty to never send this value. Any value other than empty, No, False or 0 makes the leave start at midday.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_HALF_DAY_END_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the half-day flag for the last day. Optional; leave empty to never send this value. Any value other than empty, No, False or 0 makes the leave end at midday.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_ABSENCE_COMMENT_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the reason or comment to copy to Personio. Optional; leave empty to never send this value.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_PERSONIO_ABSENCE_ID_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID of a single-line text field that receives the Personio absence period ID. Required: it is the duplicate guard, and a work item that already holds an ID is never processed again.

flowVariables.name: PERSONIO_SKIP_APPROVAL
flowVariables.instruction: true records the absence as approved, because approval already happened in Jira; false sends it through the Personio approval workflow as well. Must be true or false.

flowVariables.name: PERSONIO_API_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Personio API v2 base URL. No trailing slash.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_COMMENTS_INTERNAL
flowVariables.instruction: true posts the result comments as JSM internal notes; false makes them visible to the requester. Must be true or false.
